readout_other: video-EEG/ECoG seizure counts, duration and inter-seizure interval; T2-weighted MRI; skull-surface thermal infrared imaging
direction_notes: Penicillin-induced seizures were fewer after 15 min of ultrasound than after sham (total count over 7 h 75.75 vs 129.1); seizure duration and inter-seizure interval changes had p = 0.0544.
safety_notes: Skull-surface temperature rise was about 0.3 C and T2-weighted MRI showed no tissue damage or bleeding.

timing.protocol_description: Low-intensity pulsed ultrasound (PRF 500 Hz, duty cycle 36%) was delivered for 15 minutes, 30 minutes after penicillin injection, to the right hand movement area; the animals were fixed on a primate chair for 7 hours afterwards with video-EEG. Sessions were separated by 14-day intervals.
A 750 kHz Sonic Concepts transducer was compared with the 800 kHz transducer for parameter selection (Figure 2A); no separate parameters are stated for it.

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The frequency was set to 500 Hz, and the pulse duration was set to 100 ms using a first function generator, with rise and fall times set to 1 ms using a second generator (AFG3101, Tektronix) connected to the amplitude modulation entry of the first generator.

flags.reason: Methods give 'pulse duration 100 ms' with PRF 500 Hz and duty cycle 36%; these are mutually inconsistent (36%/500 Hz would be 0.72 ms). Recorded as stated.

Paper says pressure was estimated in the brains from skull transmission measured on ex vivo skulls; also says 'pressure amplitude at the focus was 1.74 MPa'. Method labelled measurement (through skull) but could be derating.
Paper gives 'less than 1431.71 mW/cm2' (upper bound), converted to 1.43171 W/cm2.
Two monkeys; figure legends give n = 8 (sessions/trials).
750 kHz transducer was used only for parameter selection; no timing or pressure stated for it. Frequency text is 750 kHz.
Sham stimulation described only as a control group; mechanism not stated.
Stimulation delivered under isoflurane; anaesthesia removed after 15 min and video-EEG continued for 7 h.
